lead: It looks like you're building a superintelligence!
tips: Would you like help?
Tip: a Gateway next to a path is worth ten press releases.
Tip: researchers who nap ship 25% more, according to a survey of researchers who nap.
Tip: the Kombucha Bar is load-bearing. Do not remove the Kombucha Bar.
Tip: 10× speed is called Grueling for a reason. Hydrate.
Tip: Vibes are not a metric. Vibes are a metric.
Tip: press P to take a picture of your lab looking calm.
Tip: a thought bubble is a free user interview.
Tip: protesters are just early adopters with signs.
Tip: right-drag to pan. Left-drag to regret.
Tip: your runway is a state of mind, until it isn't.
Tip: agents work nights. Agents also edit the spec at night.
Tip: a Cluster is 600K of heat you can cash in later.
Tip: the Arena is a snapshot. The Arena is always about to change.
Tip: click a person to read their mind. They will not mind.
Tip: new models need a Training Hall. Halls need Clusters. Clusters need optimism.
Tip: Esc puts the tool away. Space pauses the lab. Nothing pauses the discourse.
Tip: if the campus is quiet, someone has scheduled a meeting.
Tip: every toast is dismissible. Every problem is not.
Tip: you can change the look of everything from Start ▸ Settings ▸ Display…
